nodes.label: Separate Durable State Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Only facts CENTRAL decides or must remember are persisted; live connectivity and telemetry are runtime-only because they become stale after restart or produce unnecessary writes.

nodes.label: End Reason Observation Model
nodes.rationale: Engine-observed ends are distinct from CENTRAL-inferred ends; startup closes unfinished irrigations as CENTRAL_RESTART because no final event can arrive.

nodes.label: Database-Enforced Invariants
nodes.rationale: Partial unique indexes and checks make one open fault, one live irrigation, replay-safe request identifiers, and consistent request fields race-safe database guarantees.

nodes.label: Request Audit and Idempotency
nodes.rationale: Requests are recorded for auditability and idempotency, except requests naming unknown stations or operators because foreign keys would reject them.

nodes.label: Station Self-Enrollment
nodes.rationale: Stations must supply both an identifier and location so unknown stations can enroll, known stations can authenticate and refresh their last-seen state, and malformed registrations can be rejected.
